questions.text_zh: 联系方式（微信/手机/邮箱，仅用于约时间）
请根据你的实际情况，在以下每个陈述后选择你的同意程度。
questions.text_en: Please indicate how much you agree with each statement.

answers.zh: 我承认我的想法和态度可能是错的。
answers.en: I question my own opinions, positions, and viewpoints because they could be wrong.

answers.zh: 我会根据新证据重新考虑自己的观点。
answers.en: I reconsider my opinions when presented with new evidence.

answers.zh: 我尊重跟我看法不同的人的观点。
answers.en: I recognize the value in opinions that are different from my own.

answers.zh: 我接受我的信念和态度可能有错。
answers.en: I accept that my beliefs and attitudes may be wrong.

answers.zh: 面对相反的证据，我愿意改变自己的看法。
answers.en: In the face of conflicting evidence, I am open to changing my opinions.

answers.zh: 我喜欢了解与我已有认知不同的新信息。
answers.en: I like finding out new information that differs from what I already think is true.

questions.text_zh: 请根据你的实际看法，在以下每个陈述后选择你的同意程度。
questions.text_en: Please indicate how much you agree with each statement.

answers.zh: 一个人的聪明程度是天生固定的，无法真正改变。
answers.en: You have a certain amount of intelligence, and you can't really do much to change it.

answers.zh: 人可以学习新东西，但改变不了自己的基本智力水平。
answers.en: You can learn new things, but you can't really change your basic intelligence.

answers.zh: 不管是谁，都无法显著改变自己的能力水平。
answers.en: No matter who you are, you can't significantly change your ability level.

questions.text_zh: 请根据你的实际情况，在以下每个陈述后选择你的同意程度。
questions.text_en: Please indicate how much you agree with each statement.

answers.zh: 我不喜欢不确定的情境。
answers.en: I don't like situations that are uncertain.

answers.zh: 我不喜欢那些可以有许多不同答案的问题。
answers.en: I dislike questions which could be answered in many different ways.

answers.zh: 我发现我的性格适合井井有条、循规蹈矩的生活方式。
answers.en: I find that a well-ordered life with regular hours suits my temperament.

answers.zh: 如果不明白生活中某件事为什么发生，我会觉得不舒服。
answers.en: I feel uncomfortable when I don't understand the reason why an event occurred in my life.

answers.zh: 当一个人和群体里其他所有人意见都不一致时，我会觉得烦躁。
answers.en: I feel irritated when one person disagrees with what everyone else in a group believes.

answers.zh: 我不喜欢在不知道会发生什么的情况下进入一个情境。
answers.en: I don't like to go into a situation without knowing what I can expect from it.

answers.zh: 做出决定之后，我会感到如释重负。
answers.en: When I have made a decision, I feel relieved.

answers.zh: 面对一个问题时，我非常渴望尽快找到答案。
answers.en: When I am confronted with a problem, I'm dying to reach a solution very quickly.

answers.zh: 如果不能立即找到解决办法，我会很快变得不耐烦和恼火。
answers.en: I would quickly become impatient and irritated if I would not find a solution to a problem immediately.

answers.zh: 我不愿意与可能作出意想不到的行为的人在一起。
answers.en: I don't like to be with people who are capable of unexpected actions.

answers.zh: 我不喜欢一句话可以有很多种理解的情况。
answers.en: I dislike it when a person's statement could mean many different things.

answers.zh: 我发现建立始终如一的规律能使我更好地享受生活。
answers.en: I find that establishing a consistent routine enables me to enjoy life more.

answers.zh: 我喜欢有条不紊的生活方式。
answers.en: I enjoy having a clear and structured mode of life.

answers.zh: 在形成自己的观点之前，我通常不会去征询很多不同的意见。
answers.en: I do not usually consult many different opinions before forming my own view.

answers.zh: 我不喜欢不可预测的情境。
answers.en: I dislike unpredictable situations.

questions.text_zh: 请根据你的实际情况，在以下每个陈述后选择符合你的程度。
questions.text_en: Please indicate how characteristic each statement is of you.

answers.zh: 无法预料的事情会让我心烦意乱。
answers.en: Unforeseen events upset me greatly.

answers.zh: 如果不能拥有我所需要的全部信息，我会很沮丧。
answers.en: It frustrates me not having all the information I need.

answers.zh: 不确定性使我很难拥有一个完美的生活。
answers.en: Uncertainty keeps me from living a full life.

answers.zh: 我做事总会未雨绸缪，以避免措手不及。
answers.en: One should always look ahead so as to avoid surprises.

answers.zh: 即使有最好的计划，一个小意外也能搞砸我的全盘计划。
answers.en: A small unforeseen event can spoil everything, even with the best of planning.

answers.zh: 当到了采取行动的时候，不确定性会让我停滞不前。
answers.en: When it's time to act, uncertainty paralyses me.

answers.zh: 当我感到不确定时，我就不能很好的表现自己。
answers.en: When I am uncertain I can't function very well.

answers.zh: 我总是想知道我的未来是什么样子的。
answers.en: I always want to know what the future has in store for me.

answers.zh: 我无法忍受突发状况。
answers.en: I can't stand being taken by surprise.

answers.zh: 一点点的疑虑都会阻止我行动。
answers.en: The smallest doubt can stop me from acting.

answers.zh: 在做事之前，我应该能够规划好一切。
answers.en: I should be able to organize everything in advance.

answers.zh: 我必须摆脱所有不确定的情形。
answers.en: I must get away from all uncertain situations.

questions.text_zh: 请回想你感到郁闷、情绪低落的时候，以下情况符合你的程度：
questions.text_en: When you feel down, sad, or depressed, how often do you...

answers.zh: 我常常想我究竟做了什么会导致这样。
answers.en: Think "What am I doing to deserve this?"

answers.zh: 我常常想我为什么总是这样。
answers.en: Think "Why do I always react this way?"

answers.zh: 我常常思考现状，希望它有所好转。
answers.en: Think about a recent situation, wishing it had gone better.

answers.zh: 我常常想为什么我有这些问题，而别人却没有。
answers.en: Think "Why do I have problems other people don't have?"

answers.zh: 我常常想我为什么不能把事情处理得更好。
answers.en: Think "Why can't I handle things better?"

questions.text_zh: 以下句子描述人们在亲近关系中的感受。请针对你生活中普遍的亲近关系（如亲密朋友、家人）作答。
questions.text_en: The following concern how you feel in close relationships in general.

answers.zh: 我经常与他们讨论我所遇到的问题以及我关心的事情。
answers.en: I usually discuss my problems and concerns with them.

answers.zh: 我跟他们什么事情都讲。
answers.en: I talk things over with them.

answers.zh: 我觉得依赖他们是很自在的事情。
answers.en: I find it easy to depend on them.

answers.zh: 我觉得对他们开诚布公不是一件很舒服的事情。
answers.en: I don't feel comfortable opening up to them.

answers.zh: 总的来说，我不喜欢让他们知道自己内心深处的感觉。
answers.en: I prefer not to show them how I feel deep down.

answers.zh: 在需要的时候，我向他们求助是很有用的。
answers.en: It helps to turn to them in times of need.

answers.zh: 我常担心他们并不真正在乎我。
answers.en: I often worry that they don't really care for me.

answers.zh: 我担心我会被抛弃。
answers.en: I'm afraid that they may abandon me.

answers.zh: 我担心他们不会像我关心他们那样地关心我。
answers.en: I worry that they won't care about me as much as I care about them.

answers.zh: 学习/工作上表现好的时候，我感觉自己更有价值。

answers.zh: 每当考试或考核表现差，我的自尊心就受打击。
answers.en: My self-esteem suffers whenever I do poorly on an exam or evaluation.

answers.zh: 我对自己的评价，很大程度上取决于我在学业/工作上的表现。

answers.zh: 知道自己在学业/工作上比别人强，会让我自我感觉良好。
answers.en: Knowing I do better than others academically/professionally makes me feel good about myself.

answers.zh: 学业/工作上的挫折会让我怀疑自己的价值。
answers.en: Academic/professional setbacks make me doubt my worth.
